finding: Sibling SubAgentActivityCard uses <Card size="sm"> for compact density in the same narrow panel context; this card renders <Card className="shrink-0"> with no size="sm", a density divergence from the precedent it mirrors.

The token meta uses a leading mid-dot baked into the string ('· {tokens} tokens') inside a flex-wrap row; if the tokens Text wraps to its own line at 390px the '·' renders as an orphaned line-start separator (the dot is content, not a flex gap).

Comment claims the status pill 'drops UNDER the title at 390px'; the title is flex-1 min-w-0 line-clamp-2 so it shrinks and the pill stays on the same row (verified in the 390px render). Behavior is correct (no clip) but the comment overstates the reflow; ms-auto is redundant beside a flex-1 sibling.
